mapper.sql: sys_house_rent_record shrr left join sys_company sc on sc.id = shrr.company_id left join sys_house sh on sh.id = shrr.house_id left join sys_building sb on sb.id = sh.building_id left join sys_organization sp on sp.id = sc.park_org_id

sys_house_rent_renew_record shrrr left join sys_house_rent_record shrr on shrr.id = shrrr.rent_record_id left join sys_company sc on sc.id = shrr.company_id left join sys_house sh on sh.id = shrr.house_id left join sys_building sb on sb.id = sh.building_id left join sys_organization sp on sp.id = sc.park_org_id
mapper.select:
select shrr.id,shrr.rent_start_time,shrr.rent_end_time,sh.name houseName,sh.build_area,sh.cover_area,sb.name buildingName,sp.org_name parkOrgName,sc.name companyName from
shrr.id = #{id} and shrr.deleted = 0

select shrr.rent_start_time,sh.name houseName,sb.name buildingName,sp.org_name parkOrgName,sc.name companyName,shrrr.rent_end_time,shrrr.renew_end_time,shrrr.create_time from
shrrr.rent_record_id = #{rentRecordId} and shrrr.deleted = 0
order by shrrr.create_time desc
